angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 413,246 km at 187.46 pc = 0.03 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.3345 +/- 0.0378 mas (same row, RUWE 1.18): 187.46 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.594 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Fernandes et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5573 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract): 413,246 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.619 +/- 0.023 solar masses from Fernandes et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5573 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3790 +/- 59 K from Fernandes et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5573 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Fernandes et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5573 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5573.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.682, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-5573: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5573 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.42 dex, from Fernandes et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5573 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.15927, from Fernandes et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5573 (pscomppars): age 9.7 Gyr, from Fernandes et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5573 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Fernandes et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....170...55F/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
